create_MegaDepth_dataset: create a MegaDepth dataset instance with a specified split and ROOT path for stereo view data
load_MegaDepth_metadata: load MegaDepth scene, image, and pair metadata from an all_metadata.npz file
select_MegaDepth_scene: select specific scenes or instances from the MegaDepth dataset pairs using scene_id filtering
get_MegaDepth_views: get stereo view pairs with images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for a given pair index
get_MegaDepth_stats: get statistics about the number of pairs and scenes in the MegaDepth dataset
